whatsappMessage:
Hi Samundri Aquarium,

I noticed your aquarium shop has built strong 4.0★ reviews across 460+ local customers in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for aquarium setup inquiries and livestock availability.

Maine aapke store ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp fish/tank inquiry, livestock catalog, aur Boring Road store directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/samundri

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Samundri Aquarium team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with mobile-first speed, direct WhatsApp fish and tank inquiries, and your prominent location near Varun Bihar Restaurant on Boring Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact aquarium varieties, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
